# #654 L2 re-freeze: every changed existing row and its cause

34-book / 113-query fixture (books 133-134 and `uk-01`..`uk-08` added) vs the 32-book baselines, at f4e97cc8. Rule 7954498d with amendment (b) d7c2b6de (Artem decided). Stemmer neutrality: the same code on the 32-book fixture reproduces all 315 lists on every tier (`pnpm eval --gate` PASS, 0 changed; hash tier 0 changed).

Causes: **new book** = 133 or 134 is in the new top-10; **corpus statistics** = no new book in the list, the two added books shift BM25 IDF and the #651 df-share prune (keyword half, so keyword and hybrid rows); **rerank pool** = a vector row reranked over a pool a new book entered.
